elements.name: SRD 5.1 Monsters
elements.description:
System Reference Document 5.1 monsters and nonplayer characters, released by Wizards of the Coast LLC under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

This work includes material taken from the System Reference Document 5.1 ("SRD 5.1") by Wizards of the Coast LLC and available at https://dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document. The SRD 5.1 is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License available at https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode. Modified: the SRD stat blocks were structured into typed JSON data (sizes, types, numbers and attacks were parsed from the printed text; hyphenation and line breaks were normalised).
